stories.title: Poland is sounding the alarm that Russia may broaden its war in Europe
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Richard Haass, Council on Foreign Relations' president emeritus, about the Polish prime minister's warning that Russia may be planning attacks on NATO countries.

stories.title: Trump threatens CNN, MSNow and Politico
stories.summary: President Trump threatens to ban three major news organizations from the White House. It's his latest salvo in an ongoing war on the media.

stories.title: When Trump and Xi meet they will discuss AI. 'Track Two' talks are already buzzing
stories.summary: An informal network of dialogues at think tanks and universities is bringing together experts from the U.S. and China to talk about the shared perils of AI — and possible paths forward.

stories.title: Diesel prices reach record territory, creating ripple effects throughout the economy
stories.summary: Diesel prices soared to another record high today, averaging $6.44 a gallon. Trucking, farming, and flying is getting more expensive. But so far it hasn't crimped most Americans' spending.

stories.title: Could trees developed with gene-editing technology protect Florida's citrus industry?
stories.summary: A bacterial infection is wiping out Florida's citrus trees. Growers hope a rootstock developed with gene-editing technology could keep the disease at bay.

stories.title: Scientists find evidence of ancient drug use in prehistoric teeth
stories.summary: A new study on ancient human remains finds evidence for the habitual use of betel nuts, dating back to the Ice Age. The finding offers some of the oldest archaeological evidence of psychoactive drug use, and potential insights into how use of betel nuts, now popular for their stimulant effects, evolved.
